categories.main_business_segments: Arisawa Mfg. Co., Ltd. operates four main business segments: Electronic Materials (flexible and rigid printed circuit board materials), Industrial Structural Materials (FRP pressure vessels for water treatment, aircraft honeycomb panels, and pultruded products), Electrical Insulation Materials (glass cloth, tapes, and prepregs), and Display Materials (3D display filters and polarization components). The company also engages in related product sales, logistics, and other services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies are based on proprietary 'weaving, coating, and shaping' techniques. Key production methods include advanced resin formulation and coating for high-performance electronic materials, environmentally friendly prepreg and honeycomb panel manufacturing for aircraft interiors, and precision optical component fabrication for display materials. The company emphasizes energy-efficient and high-durability material development, such as quick-press FPC coverlays and halogen/antimony-free prepregs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are manufacturers of information devices, electronic components, and industrial electronic equipment. Major end markets include the electronics industry (especially for smartphones, semiconductors, and data centers), automotive (EVs and next-generation mobility), water treatment, energy (fuel cells, batteries, hydrogen), aerospace, and medical/industrial display applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: Arisawa operates globally with key production and sales bases in Japan, Taiwan, China, the United States, and Europe (notably Spain). Sales are well-diversified, with significant revenue from Japan, China, and other international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is primarily positioned midstream, supplying advanced materials and components to manufacturers of electronic devices, industrial equipment, and end-product assemblers. It also provides some downstream finished products, such as display filters and pressure vessels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing differentiated products using proprietary technologies, expanding into new business domains, and deepening existing segments. R&D focuses on high-performance, energy-saving, and environmentally friendly materials for electronics, mobility, energy, and display applications. The company is also committed to ESG themes, such as carbon neutrality by 2030, circular economy initiatives, and human capital development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of manufactured products (materials and components) to B2B customers. Some segments also include contract manufacturing, licensing, and related services such as logistics.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include global and domestic advanced materials manufacturers in the electronics, industrial, and display sectors. Arisawa positions itself as a technology-driven, niche leader with strong differentiation in high-value-added materials, particularly in flexible electronics and specialty composites.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales were 49.8 billion yen, with operating profit of 4.89 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 3.97 billion yen. The company demonstrated strong growth, with sales up 18.3% and net profit up 142% year-on-year, driven by recovery in electronics and robust display materials. The company maintains a solid balance sheet with high equity ratio and stable cash flow.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Arisawa emphasizes unique value through proprietary technologies that enable high-performance, energy-efficient, and environmentally conscious materials. Its differentiation lies in advanced resin and coating technologies, rapid response to customer needs, and the ability to deliver customized, high-quality solutions for next-generation electronics, mobility, and display applications. The company also highlights its commitment to sustainability and innovation as key drivers of customer value.
